# Netsidian 0.5.1

This patch release clarifies the graph view and adds reading guides to the file explorer.

- The graph view's title now reads **Graph** (previously "Knowledge map"), matching its existing accessible name. The link and topic-atlas layouts are unchanged.
- The file explorer draws vertical tree guide lines that connect each folder to its children, resolved from the full visible hierarchy before virtualization so guides stay correct while scrolling. A last sibling ends its parent's guide at its own row centre, and a small horizontal tick marks that last-child endpoint.
- README screenshots refreshed: a denser graph link layout, a new topic-atlas capture, and dark/light/mobile file-explorer captures.

## Downloads and deployment

Desktop archives cover Linux x64, Windows x64, macOS Intel and Apple Silicon.
Linux requires GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0; Windows requires WebView2 Runtime. macOS
bundles are ad-hoc signed and are not Apple notarized. Each archive includes
installation instructions and the license. Verify downloads using `SHA256SUMS`.

```sh
docker run -d --name netsidian -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -v netsidian-state:/netsidian-state ghcr.io/pentaqilo/netsidian:0.5.1
```

The Helm package uses chart version and application image tag `0.5.1`.
`docker-image.txt` records the immutable multi-platform image digest.
